title: Testing the support draft activity: mock start_raw and llm_attempts
answers: how to simulate a retry attempt in the draft activity tests
body:
Tests are in products/conversations/backend/temporal/tests/test_pipeline.py (TestDraftWithoutJson, TestUntrustedTicketGuard, TestDiagnosticScopes).
Patch these under DRAFT_MODULE: _hydrate_chunks, resolve_user_id_for_support, get_or_create_support_sandbox_env, and MultiTurnSession.start_raw. Patch start_raw, not start. It returns (session, text) or raises.
To choose the attempt number, patch f"{DRAFT_MODULE}.llm_attempts" to return 1 or 2. Attempt 1 should raise DraftNotProducedError. Attempt 2 should return a blocked draft.
To drive the nudge path, build the session as a MagicMock with an AsyncMock `end` and an AsyncMock `send_followup_raw` (set return_value, or side_effect for crashes). For an empty turn, use EmptyAgentTurnError("empty", total_lines=1, printed_lines=0).
A valid first-turn payload is the _OK_DRAFT_JSON string. The fake returns raw JSON text, not a SupportReplyDraft.
applies: Unit tests for products/conversations draft activity
